temples.name: Shree sharda mata mandir Patloni
temples.timing: 6 am to 12 pm 3 pm to 10 pm
temples.description: Shree Sharda Mata Mandir, Patloni, District Damoh, Madhya Pradesh is an ancient temple dedicated to Maa Sharda Mata. Believed to be around 500 years old, it is a major center of faith for devotees from nearby villages. Special celebrations are held during Chaitra Navratri, Sharadiya Navratri and Purnima.
